notes: AFQT 31 is stated on goarmy.com ('requires a score of at least 31 to enlist') and matches the lowest accepted Test Score Category in AR 601-210 para 2-8d (TSC IIIB = AFQT 31-49).

afqtMinimumGed is null / no separate floor: current AR 601-210 (20 Mar 2026) para 3-5a says 'Applicant is eligible for enlistment if they are a GED holder or higher level of education credential.' The long-circulated GED figure of 50 (and the ARNG variant of 40) does NOT appear in the 20 Mar 2026 regulation nor in the 16 May 2005 edition - treat it as LEGACY and UNVERIFIED for 2025-2026.

AR 601-210 para 3-6a: if the applicant is not MOS qualified, the AFQT 'must fall within minimum acceptable DoD quality mark standards for the annual accessions cohort' - i.e. the GED limitation is now a cohort quality-mark/percentage cap, not a published individual score floor.

Age: goarmy.com 'between 17 and 42'; nationalguard.com 'between the ages of 17 and 42'. AR 601-210 summary of change: 'Increases the maximum enlistment age up to and including age 42 for non-prior service applicants.' Prior-service applicants may also enter active duty after 42 under stated conditions.

Test-score waivers do not exist: AR 601-210 para 2-8 opening - 'Waiver requests will not be considered if applicant does not meet requirements discussed in this paragraph (or administration of tests and retests).' Medical, moral, dependency and age waivers are separate and do exist.

TSC bands per AR 601-210 para 2-8d: I 93-99; II 65-92; IIIA 50-64; IIIB 31-49; IVA 16-30; IVB 10-15 (not accepted, except 09L); V 0-9 (ineligible, except 09L). officialasvab.com publishes different bands (IVA 21-30, IVB 16-20, IVC 10-15) - a real, unresolved source disagreement.
All applicants must have ASVAB scores to enlist; the MOS aptitude-area requirement is waived only for prior-service enlistees returning to their former MOS (AR 601-210 para 3-6b/c).

Physical: each MOS in DA Pam 611-21 sec. 10C also carries a physical demands rating, a PULHES profile and an OPAT standard (e.g. 11B requires OPAT at the 'Heavy (Black)' demand category). ASVAB scores alone do not qualify an applicant.

lineScores.name: General Technical
lineScores.description: The only Army composite whose exact formula DoD publishes. Gates OCS/WOCS/WOFT entry (110), 13-series (87), SF 18-series (110), 17C/25D/25E, 51C, 79R, 31D, 12P.

lineScores.name: Clerical
lineScores.formula: VE + AR + MK (widely published form; DoD does not publish Army composite weights)
lineScores.description: goarmy.com lists VE, AR and MK as the drivers. Gates 42A and 56M (90), 36B (101), 27D (105).

lineScores.name: Combat
lineScores.formula: VE + AS + MC (goarmy.com component list); older third-party tables print VE + AR + AS + MC
lineScores.description: Gates 11B/11C/19C/19D/19K (77), 12B (82), 92R, and the CO 100 half of the SF 18-series gate. The addition of AR found in many study guides is UNVERIFIED.

lineScores.name: Field Artillery
lineScores.formula: AR + MK + MC (goarmy.com components); legacy tables print AR + CS + MK + MC
lineScores.description: Still a valid aptitude area but no current enlistment MOS in the 2024-2026 tables gates on FA: the 13-series moved to GT 87 effective 202408.

lineScores.name: General Maintenance
lineScores.formula: GS + AS + MK + EI (goarmy.com components); legacy tables print AR + AS + MC + VE
lineScores.description: Heavy use across engineering and logistics: 12N (85), 12K/12M/12W/92W/88H (88), 12G (93), 89D (105), 92R (78), 91E.

lineScores.name: Mechanical Maintenance
lineScores.formula: AS + MC + EI (goarmy.com components); legacy tables print AR + AS + MC + VE

lineScores.name: Surveillance & Communications
lineScores.description: Gates 15W/15C (102), 25U (95 with EL 95), 17E (105 with ST and EL 105).

lineScores.name: Skilled Technical
lineScores.formula: GS + VE + MC + MK (goarmy.com components); legacy tables print VE + AR + MK + MC

lineScores.name: Verbal Expression (composite input, not an aptitude area)
lineScores.formula: optimally weighted composite of unrounded WK and PC standard scores (official description); plain WK + PC is the usual approximation
lineScores.description: Not gated on by any MOS; it is the verbal block inside GT/CL/CO/OF/SC/ST. officialasvab.com footnote: 'VE is a verbal composite formed from an optimally weighted composite of unrounded WK and PC standard scores.'

lineScores.name: Armed Forces Qualification Test (percentile)
lineScores.formula: percentile rank (0-99) of a composite built from AR, MK, WK and PC standard scores, normed on the 1997 national sample of 18-23 year-olds; DoD does not publish the weights (the 2VE + AR + MK form is widely quoted but UNVERIFIED)
lineScores.description: Used for enlistment eligibility only (Army minimum 31), never for MOS assignment.

officerPathways.title: Officer Candidate School (OCS) - federal OCS / Enlistment Program 9D
officerPathways.summary: AR 601-210 (20 Mar 2026) para 9-10: 'OCS and WOFT applicants must have a general technical score of 110 or greater.' Bachelor's degree required; U.S. citizen; age 19 to less than 33 at shipment to training and commission before 34 (waivers considered); Secret clearance eligibility; no more than 10 cumulative years of active federal service at appointment.
otherRequirements: Bachelor's degree (senior in final semester may enlist in DEP)
U.S. citizen
Age 19-32 at shipment; commission before 34 (waivers considered)
Secret clearance eligibility
At most 10 years cumulative active federal service at appointment
Commissioning physical per AR 40-501; AR 600-9 body composition
No previous failure to complete an officer-producing program (waiver possible after 1 year)

officerPathways.title: Army National Guard OCS (State OCS / NGB Accelerated OCS)
officerPathways.summary: AR 601-210 para 9-10 directs that ARNG OCS/WOCS options follow the Accession Options Criteria (AOC); the GT 110 gate is the Program 9D standard. goarmy.com describes the two ARNG routes: State OCS run on weekends over 16-18 months, and NGB Accelerated OCS, an 8-week course.
otherRequirements: GT 110 (same standard as federal OCS)
State AOC / State OCS board governs any waiver - confirm with the State program
Federal recognition on commissioning (NGR 600-101)

officerPathways.title: Army ROTC (and the ROTC/SMP enlistment option)
officerPathways.summary: ROTC itself does not gate commissioning on a GT score. For the ROTC/SMP enlistment option AR 601-210 requires SAT 850, ACT 19 or PSAT 85 for non-scholarship applicants; where those scores are unavailable or not met, 'recruiting brigade commanders may approve waivers ... in cases where applicant achieved a general technical score of 110 or higher. All applicants must have an ASVAB score of record to enlist.'
otherRequirements: SAT 850 / ACT 19 / PSAT 85 (non-scholarship)
GT 110 can substitute for missing or failed SAT/ACT/PSAT via brigade commander waiver
ASVAB score of record required to enlist (SMP)
Commission before age 31 standard (waivers to 39 for uniquely qualified RFD-only applicants)
PMS certification; enroll in ROTC Basic/Advanced Course
officerPathways.source: AR 601-210 (20 Mar 2026) ROTC/SMP enlistment option paragraphs

officerPathways.title: U.S. Military Academy (West Point)
officerPathways.summary: No ASVAB or GT requirement identified in the official sources reviewed. USMA admission rests on SAT/ACT, academic record, physical aptitude and a Congressional nomination; goarmy.com notes commissioning from West Point must occur before age 27.
otherRequirements: SAT/ACT plus academic record
Congressional or Service-connected nomination
Medical qualification and Candidate Fitness Assessment
Commission before age 27 per goarmy.com

officerPathways.title: Direct Commission (JAG 27A, Chaplain 56A, AMEDD)
officerPathways.summary: UNVERIFIED. No ASVAB/GT line-score gate appears in AR 601-210 for direct-commission professional accessions; those programs are governed by their own branch authorities and substitute professional credentialing. Do not publish a GT number for these paths without a primary source.
otherRequirements: Professional degree and licensure (JD and bar admission; MD/DO and license; etc.)
Chaplain: ecclesiastical endorsement plus 72+ semester hours
Age/medical standards per AR 40-501
officerPathways.source: UNVERIFIED - no primary source fetched in this session

officerPathways.title: Warrant Officer Candidate School (WOCS)
officerPathways.summary: DA Pam 601-6 (21 Aug 2023) para 2-3a(3): 'Applicants must achieve a GT score of 110 or higher.' Para 2-2e: 'The requirements for a minimum general technical (GT) aptitude area score of 110, a high school diploma or general education diploma (GED), and possession of a secret security clearance are not waiverable.'
otherRequirements: HS diploma or GED
Interim Secret to apply, completed Secret to attend WOCS
GT 110 - expressly NOT waiverable
U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident
AFT within 6 months of application; AR 600-9
Meet the specific WO MOS prerequisites (DA Pam 611-21 ch. 8); proponent waivers case by case
Army goal of 8 or fewer years of service; 12-year active cap (8 for 153A)

officerPathways.title: Warrant Officer Flight Training (WOFT / street-to-seat)
officerPathways.summary: GT 110 via AR 601-210 para 9-10. AR 611-110 (9 Aug 2023) para 2-1 requires a qualifying SIFT score before selection for Initial-Entry Rotary Wing, age over 18 and not yet 33 at board selection, at most 8 years active federal service, and a Class 1A flight duty medical exam (which may not be requested until SIFT is passed). AR 611-110 never prints the numeric SIFT minimum - 40 is the figure commonly cited but is UNVERIFIED here.
otherRequirements: Qualifying SIFT score (numeric minimum not in AR 611-110; 40 commonly cited = UNVERIFIED)
Only one SIFT retest, and only after a failing first attempt; retest no sooner than the 46th day
Age over 18, not yet 33 at board selection
At most 8 years active federal service at DA Form 61 signature
Class 1A flight physical after passing SIFT
GT 110

officerPathways.title: Green to Gold (Army ROTC, incl. Active Duty Option)
officerPathways.summary: Army ROTC Green to Gold Active Duty Option Handbook 2026-2027, requirement 13: 'GT Score. Must have a score of 110 or higher on the General Technical (GT) Aptitude Area ...' The score must appear on the Soldier Talent Profile; an Education Center ASVAB score sheet may be used as the source document.
otherRequirements: GT 110 or higher, documented on the Soldier Talent Profile
U.S. citizenship
Security clearance documented (may be redacted on STP)
Commander recommendation/endorsement
ROTC ADO eligibility: age, AFT, medical, academic acceptance

officerPathways.title: Enlistment options 09S (OCS candidate) and 09W (WOFT candidate)
officerPathways.summary: 09S and 09W are accession codes, not aptitude areas: the applicant enlists under Program 9D (U.S. Army Officer/Warrant Officer Enlistment Program) and ships to OCS or WOFT after BCT. Both require GT 110 or greater. 09L (translator aide) is the sole case in AR 601-210 where AFQT categories IVB/V are accepted.
otherRequirements: GT 110
Bachelor's (09S) or HS diploma/GED (09W)
Secret clearance eligibility
DEP/DTP members may not process for OCS or WOFT
Guaranteed OCS/WOFT enrollment after BCT (NPS) or immediately (PS)
